description: This file defines the PostgreSQLUuidType class, which extends CharType to handle UUID data types in PostgreSQL, particularly converting UUIDs stored as CHAR(38) with whitespace to CHAR(36). It customizes data type handling for PostgreSQL databases within the Liquibase framework.

classes.name: PostgreSQLUuidType
classes.description: A custom data type class for handling UUID columns in PostgreSQL, converting CHAR(38) to CHAR(36) and extending CharType.

methods.name: toDatabaseDataType
methods.description: Converts the internal type to CHAR(36) for PostgreSQL if the size is 38, otherwise delegates to the superclass.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this data type, which is one higher than the superclass's priority.
